lines.name: CARD
lines.text: He slides a red envelope across the counter.

lines.name: STRANGER
lines.text: The Biscayne Championship. Saturday, noon. Two-fifty seat. It's paid.

lines.name: YOU
lines.text: Why would you give that to a stranger?

lines.name: STRANGER
lines.text: Because I sat on that stool once. Somebody bought my pie too.

lines.name: STRANGER
lines.text: Three things. Fold the junk. Pressure the scared ones. And near the money, think about what the money's worth, not the chips.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text:
He drops cash for both checks and is gone before the bell over the door stops ringing.
Inside the envelope: a seat card, and one line in pen.
